projects.name: ImperialStay
techStack: Express.js Database: MongoDB Atlas / Mongoose ORM Authentication: JWT (JSON Web Tokens)
HTTP-Only Cookies Real-Time Communication: Socket.IO WebSockets Security & Logging: Helmet
Cloudinary API Document Generation: PDFKit (Invoices & Salary Slips) Emails: Nodemailer SMTP API Spec: Swagger / OpenAPI 3.0 (server/swagger.json) Frontend (src/) Core: React 18
JavaScript Routing & Querying: React Router DOM v6
React Query Styling: Pure Vanilla CSS
Dark Obsidian & Light Pearl Themes (Zero Tailwind or Bootstrap) Charts: Chart.js (react-chartjs-2) Forms & Validation: React Hook Form
Yup Validation Schema Notifications: React Hot Toast
